detail.longDescription: If you expose # selfhosted services to the Internet, why accept traffic from places you’re not expecting to be? I hardly ever travel abroad so I reject requests that appear to come from other countries. Logs show I drop about 95% of opportunistic and/or malicious bots before they reach the application. # nginx and # caddy both have geoip modules, although you might need to roll your own Docker containers if you do that. # infosec # security
